name: Art Institute of Chicago
description: World-renowned art museum with an extensive Impressionist collection and the iconic lion statues out front.

name: Millennium Park & The Bean
description: Downtown park home to the famous reflective 'Cloud Gate' sculpture, popular for photos and people-watching.

name: Chicago Riverwalk Architecture Tour
description: A guided boat tour along the Chicago River highlighting the city's famous skyscraper architecture.

name: Lincoln Park Zoo
description: One of the few free zoos in the country, set inside a large lakefront park.

name: Chicago Riverwalk Bike Rental
description: Rent a bike and ride the paved Riverwalk and Lakefront Trail past downtown skyscrapers and Lake Michigan.

name: Second City Comedy Show
description: Live improv and sketch comedy at the legendary theater that launched many well-known comedians.
